name: Morocco
description: Morocco from Volubilis and the Berber kingdoms to the Idrisids, Almoravids and Almohads, the sultans, French rule and the kingdom today.

checkpoints.name: Ancient Morocco
checkpoints.note: Jebel Irhoud holds the oldest known modern humans. Berber kingdoms traded with Carthage, and Rome built Volubilis.

checkpoints.name: The dynasties
checkpoints.note: Idris founded the first Muslim state and Fez. The Almoravids and Almohads ruled Spain, and the Saadians and Alaouites kept Morocco free of Ottoman rule.

checkpoints.name: Protectorate
checkpoints.note: France and Spain divided Morocco in 1912.

checkpoints.name: The kingdom
checkpoints.note: Morocco became independent in 1956 under King Mohammed V. It marched into Western Sahara in 1975.
